help: The functions that render, merge and read PDF files. `Novis\Pdf\Document` calls them for you, so most programs use `Document` instead.

methods.name: render
methods.returns: { data: bytes, pageCount: uint, pages: array<{ number: uint, name: ?string, strings: array<{ name: string, value: string }>, marks: array<{ name: string, value: string }> }>, dropped: array<{ property: string, value: string, selector: string, line: uint, column: uint }>, missingGlyphs: array<{ text: string, fonts: array<string>, page: uint }>, overflows: array<{ page: uint, area: string, text: string }> }
methods.help: Renders an HTML document to a PDF file. Returns the file, its pages, and what the render could not draw.

methods.name: merge
methods.help: Returns one PDF file with the chosen pages of each part, in order. An encrypted part throws a `ParseError`.

methods.name: read
methods.returns: { pageCount: uint, metadata: { title: ?string, author: ?string, subject: ?string, keywords: ?string, creator: ?string, producer: ?string }, attachments: array<{ name: string, data: bytes }>, invoiceXml: ?string }
methods.help: Reads the page count, the metadata and the attached files of a PDF file.

methods.name: readText
methods.help: Returns the text of each page in `pages` of a PDF file. Pages count from 1.

enums.name: Standard
enums.help: A PDF standard the file follows. `PdfA2b` and `PdfA3b` are for archiving, and `PdfUa1` is for screen readers.

cases.name: Whole
cases.shape: { html: string, assets: array<{ name: string, data: bytes }>, options: { standard: ?Standard, password: ?string, invoiceXml: ?string, created: ?Core\Time\Instant } }

cases.name: First
cases.shape: { document: { html: string, assets: array<{ name: string, data: bytes }>, options: { standard: ?Standard, password: ?string, invoiceXml: ?string, created: ?Core\Time\Instant } }, headerHeight: ?string, footerHeight: ?string }

cases.name: Second
cases.shape: { pages: array<{ header: ?string, footer: ?string, slots: array<{ name: string, value: string }> }> }
